footnote_text: The call option was granted pursuant to a purchase and sale agreement dated August 6, 2026 (the "Agreement"), pursuant to which the initial purchase of 176,006 shares held by the reporting person by the buyer for $1.85 per share was completed on September 30, 2026. Upon completion of that purchase, the call option became exercisable by the buyer. The grant of the call option was part of the consideration for the buyer's obligation to purchase the initial 176,006 shares.
